big.headline: Iran strikes Bahrain as tankers hit in Hormuz
big.label: IRAN STRIKES BAHRAIN
big.summary: Bahrain: Iranian attack sets a civilian industrial site ablaze, no one hurt. IRGC says it hit US positions; two tankers attacked off Khasab.

big.headline: Drones set Russian cargo ship ablaze off Finland
big.label: DRONES SET SHIP ABLAZE
big.summary: Sparta II, bound for Kaliningrad, was hit about 06:50 UTC and drifted into Finnish waters; crew evacuated. Finland: Ukraine likely behind it.

big.headline: COP31 deadlocked over fossil fuels in overtime
big.label: COP31: DEADLOCKED
big.summary: A day past deadline in Antalya, talks paused overnight. EU and Pacific states reject a draft omitting fossil fuels; 130+ countries want them named.
